questions.question: How could Kerala’s recent history of land struggles shape new models of land redistribution?
questions.solution_html:
• Kerala's history of land struggles, especially recent Adivasi-led standing protests, highlights
  • the urgent need for equitable land redistribution-these protests advocate for the restoration of
  • Adivasi land and recognition of their traditional rights- it should inspire new policy models that
  • emphasize inclusive land reform, acknowledging historical injustices and addressing long
  • standing socio-economic disparities-such governance models would prioritize community
  • based resources, environmental sustainability, and genuine participatory processes.
  • CO:4 Taxonomy: Apply(A)]

questions.question: Explain, how globalization has transformed national governance structures and practices?
questions.solution_html:
• Globalization has transformed national governance by promoting economic and
  • technological integration, influencing policy-making, and increasing international cooperation
  • national governments now engage in a complex web of global markets, transnational
  • organizations, geo-economic policies-this shift has led to the adoption of market-driven
  • reforms, regulatory changes, and global governance practices, often challenging traditional
  • conceptions of sovereignty. (U)]

questions.question: "Rights are conditions of social life without which no man can seek himself, to be at his best". Substantiate the statement.
questions.solution_html:
• Opined by Harold Laski- for Laski, men enjoy rights not merely as members of the state
  • but also as members of the society and various associations and relationships in society- the
  • material source of rights is the community’s sense of justice and not the law-Laski emphasized
  • that individual rights are fundamental for personal growth and well-being-without rights
  • individuals cannot fully express themselves, participate in society, or achieve their potential
  • limiting both their personal fulfilment and their contribution to the community-for Laski, rights
  • were not just legal entitlements but essential conditions for the flourishing of both individuals
  • and society

questions.question: Trace the evolution of political science as a distinct field of study. ***
questions.solution_html:
• Political science evolved as a distinct field of study from philosophy, focusing on the
  • analysis of political institutions, behaviour, and governance-initially dominated by political
  • theory-expanded in the 19th and 20th centuries with the development of empirical methods and
  • comparative politics-the rise of Behaviouralism, quantitative research, and interdisciplinary
  • approaches solidified its status as a separate discipline, engaging with sociology, economics
  • and history to understand power dynamics, state functions, and citizen behaviour-Post
  • Behaviouralism played a significant role in reconciling facts and values concerning politics
  • new methodologies and theoretical perspectives- today, the discipline addresses technology
  • climate issues, gender, migration, and transnational governance systems etc.
  • Taxonomy: Remember(K)]

  • ideals like democracy, equality, justice, and accountability- these principles guide governance

questions.question: How does the state maintain law and order?

questions.question: Explain the functions of law.
questions.solution_html:

  • regulates institutions- supports justice by providing rules and procedures- mechanisms for fair

questions.question: How does a government reflect the will of the state?

  • unpaid labour built much of the economic foundation of early America- Slavery contributed to

questions.question: Summarize the Kerala government’s response to the standing protest.
questions.solution_html:
• Standing protest or Nilppusamaram was led by Adivasi Gothra Maha Sabha (AGMS) in
  • the year 2014-struggles in front of the Kerala Secretariat- the main demand of the Adivasis was
  • five acres land each to all landless tribal families in the state- government faced criticism from
  • activists and observers- Kerala government responded through dialogue- administrative
  • interventions and welfare assurances- state government assured strong action to allocate the
  • land -requisite land will be also distributed to the tribes people, who are residing in the farms
  • owned by the state forest department-appropriate action would be initiated against the
  • encroachers, who are carrying out farming in tribal lands.
questions.final_answer: encroachers, who are carrying out farming in tribal lands

questions.question: Discuss how gender roles are maintained through daily practices.
questions.solution_html:
• Gender roles are maintained through daily practices like socialization- division of labour

  • about appropriate behaviour for men and women- -what men and women “should” do
  • everyday behaviours, expectations, and socialization.

questions.question: Explain the basic principles of democratic governance.
questions.solution_html:
• Democratic governance is based on several principles -popular sovereignty- political
  • equality- rule of law- accountability- transparency- participation- protection of rights- periodic
  • elections-these principles ensure that power is exercised responsibly and reflects the will and
  • interests of citizens.

questions.question: Explain the concept of constitutional democracy and its significance.
questions.solution_html:
• Constitutional democracy operates through a constitution that limits power, protects rights
  • ensures separation of powers, and upholds rule of law- significance lies in preventing
  • authoritarianism- safeguarding freedoms- promoting accountability-creating stable
  • predictable governance grounded in democratic values and legal authority.
questions.final_answer: predictable governance grounded in democratic values and legal authority

questions.question: Explain the significance of equitable vaccine distribution in the context of COVID pandemic.
questions.solution_html:
• Equitable vaccine distribution during COVID-19 was crucial to prevent global health
  • disparities- reduce mortality-control transmission- protect vulnerable populations- ensured
  • fairness, strengthened international solidarity, and enabled a coordinated response, recognizing
  • that unequal access would prolong the pandemic and worsen socio-economic inequalities
  • WHO-led initiative supporting vaccines, diagnostics, and treatments-COVAX-global
  • partnership-created to supply vaccines to low- and middle-income countries.
questions.final_answer: partnership-created to supply vaccines to low- and middle-income countries

  • worldwide used it to expose sexual harassment and assault- transforming it into a global
  • movement demanding accountability and systemic change- #MeToo exposed widespread
  • sexual harassment- empowered survivors to speak out- pressured institutions to act- increased
  • accountability- sparked global conversations on gender violence.
questions.final_answer: accountability- sparked global conversations on gender violence
